title: GardenDesigner
date_status_reading_depth: 2 Apr 2026; CVPR 2026 identified by authors/project. Selected methods, human-study discussion and project page.
lesson_and_limit: Expert asset knowledge and relation constraints are a close conceptual fit. Study concerns Jiangnan gardens, not general Cyrus planting or Max integration. Reuse the design lesson; independently evaluate our recipes.

title: Scenethesis
date_status_reading_depth: Original May 2025; primary abstract read. ICLR 2026 manuscript surfaced; OpenReview forum access encountered verification.
lesson_and_limit: Combines planning, visual refinement and physically informed optimization. Useful decomposition, but no reproduced artist preference or Cyrus performance result. Venue page was not independently inspected beyond the available manuscript evidence.

title: Infinite Photorealistic Worlds Using Procedural Generation / Infinigen
date_status_reading_depth: CVPR 2023; primary paper overview/abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Procedural nature generation can produce broad synthetic variation. Synthetic quantity does not supply aesthetic preference labels. Cyrus already has an engine; replacing it is not implied.

title: Realistic Modeling and Rendering of Plant Ecosystems
date_status_reading_depth: SIGGRAPH 1998; author paper page/overview.
lesson_and_limit: Domain-specific plant distribution, ecosystem modelling and rendering have a long history. Artist controls and structured rules remain useful. Ecological simulation and attractive studio composition are different objectives.

title: Sample-Based Vegetation Distribution Information Synthesis
date_status_reading_depth: 2015; selected overview/method material.
lesson_and_limit: Local relationships in marked point distributions suggest measurable species/spacing descriptors. Local statistical similarity alone does not establish camera composition or task success.

title: Patternshop
date_status_reading_depth: SIGGRAPH 2023; author project overview.
lesson_and_limit: Separate density from correlation/point-pattern structure. Useful vocabulary for future recipe controls. Availability and reuse terms require checking; no implementation was copied.

title: Thinking in Space / VSI-Bench
date_status_reading_depth: Original Dec 2024; CVPR 2025 paper. Abstract and paper overview.
lesson_and_limit: Spatial reasoning should be evaluated against geometric truth. Benchmark findings do not prove that every later model has the same limitations; test the selected model on Cyrus tasks.

title: Generate Any Scene
date_status_reading_depth: Original 11 Dec 2024; v4 17 Mar 2026, ICLR 2026. Primary abstract/version history.
lesson_and_limit: Structured objects/attributes/relations can systematically vary semantic coverage. Candidate benchmark generation may benefit. Semantic correctness labels are not human aesthetic preferences, and synthetic self-improvement is not evidence of Cyrus quality.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
date_status_reading_depth: 2017; primary abstract/overview.
lesson_and_limit: Pairwise human judgments can train a reward used by an interactive policy. This supports the general feedback idea; it does not make full RL necessary for parameter search.

title: Deep Interactive Evolution
date_status_reading_depth: 2018; primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Human selection can guide a generative search space. Cyrus can test local recipe mutation around favourites without adopting the paper's generative representation.

title: Multi-attribute Bayesian optimization with interactive preference learning
date_status_reading_depth: AISTATS 2020; primary paper abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Expensive design search can use uncertainty about utility and comparisons. Useful low-dimensional baseline; mixed recipe structure and Max costs require a separate experiment.

title: BoTorch BOPE tutorial
date_status_reading_depth: Versioned official tutorial, accessed 2026-10-05; model/acquisition example inspected.
lesson_and_limit: Shows preference exploration over outcomes with pairwise utility modelling. A tutorial is a starting implementation reference, not a guarantee of better landscape search.

title: Illuminating search spaces by mapping elites
date_status_reading_depth: 2015; primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Keep a repertoire across meaningful descriptors rather than only the top scalar score. Cyrus must validate the descriptors and artist value of that diversity.

title: ImageReward
date_status_reading_depth: NeurIPS 2023; primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Image preference models can learn from human comparisons. General text-to-image preferences should be tested as a baseline, not treated as professional planting authority.

title: Personalizing RLHF with Variational Preference Learning
date_status_reading_depth: NeurIPS 2024; primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Heterogeneous preferences motivate conditional rather than universal scoring. Does not determine our studio's decision policy or prove visual transfer.

title: Capturing Individual Human Preferences with Reward Features
date_status_reading_depth: NeurIPS 2025; primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Shared reward features with individual adaptation are worth comparing to separate profiles. Domain, data scale and evaluation differ from Cyrus.

title: PreferThinker
date_status_reading_depth: Original 1 Nov 2025; v4 26 Jun 2026; authors report ICLR 2026 acceptance. Abstract/version history.
lesson_and_limit: Predict-then-assess preference profiles suggest editable profile hypotheses and dimension-specific assessments. Reasoning-trained scoring is not automatically better than a small ranker on our data.

title: PrefGen
date_status_reading_depth: 4 Dec 2025 preprint; primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Multimodal preference representations can condition image generation. Transfer to a procedural recipe generator is a hypothesis, not a demonstrated capability.

title: XPASS-Vis
date_status_reading_depth: 14 Jun 2026 preprint; primary abstract/version history.
lesson_and_limit: Cross-domain personalized aesthetics includes landscape images but still has a transfer gap. The abstract says data/code will be public upon acceptance; availability was not established. Do not assume it is a ready commercial training corpus.

title: Discrete Preference Learning for Personalized Multimodal Generation
date_status_reading_depth: 22 Apr 2026; authors report SIGIR 2026 acceptance. Primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Modality-specific graphs and discrete preference tokens are a possible later representation. Evidence is for multimodal generation; it does not justify a GNN as the first Cyrus model.

title: CRED
date_status_reading_depth: 9 Mar 2026; ICRA 2026 stated in paper metadata. Primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Generate comparisons that distinguish competing preference hypotheses. Robotics trajectories and environment design differ from aesthetic planting; test the acquisition idea under equal artist effort.

title: Optimal Design for Active Preference Learning with Biased LLM Judges / NAOD
date_status_reading_depth: 30 Sep 2026, v1 preprint. Primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Active acquisition may expose residual judge bias. Keep human anchors and audit selection. Very recent language-preference evidence; no visual/Cyrus reproduction or maturity claim.

title: Direct Preference Optimization
date_status_reading_depth: 2023; primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: A later recipe language model could learn from context-matched preferred/rejected sequences. DPO does not directly train a C++ procedural evaluator or remove validity checks.

title: Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization
date_status_reading_depth: Original 2022; ICML 2023 proceedings also surfaced. Primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Optimizing an imperfect reward too hard can worsen a more faithful target. Keep independent human evaluation and capped search. The paper's synthetic reward setup is not a measured Cyrus failure rate.

title: Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization in Direct Alignment Algorithms
date_status_reading_depth: 2024; primary abstract.
lesson_and_limit: Direct alignment can also overoptimize. Choosing DPO does not remove the need for evaluation, regularization and rollback.

title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
date_status_reading_depth: 2023; primary abstract/overview.
lesson_and_limit: Model judging needs bias checks and human comparison. Transfer to multimodal planting judgments must be measured rather than inferred from language evaluation.

title: SAM 3 official repository
date_status_reading_depth: Current README/access/license sections; SAM 3.1 release noted 27 Mar 2026.
lesson_and_limit: Candidate for editable reference masks. The 3.1 update concerns multi-object video tracking. Its custom license, checkpoint access and dependency requirements need exact-version review; no installation or still-image benchmark here.

title: DINOv3 official repository
date_status_reading_depth: Current README and license notice, accessed 2026-10-05.
lesson_and_limit: Candidate frozen visual features for retrieval/ranking. Code and weights use the DINOv3 license. Benchmark an appropriate checkpoint and inspect terms before adoption; similarity is not preference.

title: Depth Anything 3 official repository
date_status_reading_depth: Current README/model table; original release noted 14 Nov 2025; refreshed checkpoint notes inspected.
lesson_and_limit: Optional depth/view cues, not automatic exact reconstruction. Weight terms vary by checkpoint; several large models are noncommercial, unlike some other variants. Pin the exact choice and use Max geometry as truth for generated scenes.

title: MCP specification
date_status_reading_depth: Dated 28 Jul 2026; official overview/contracts.
lesson_and_limit: Current protocol describes self-contained stateless requests and per-request negotiation. Existing Cyrus package versions are not proof of conformance; use compatibility tests.

title: MCP tools
date_status_reading_depth: Same dated specification; relevant structured output/annotation sections.
lesson_and_limit: Typed input/output contracts improve interoperability. An annotation is not an access-control decision; Cyrus must enforce authority and scope itself.

title: MCP Tasks extension
date_status_reading_depth: Draft as accessed; creation, polling and cancellation sections.
lesson_and_limit: Optional durable-operation envelope. Cancellation is cooperative, acknowledgement is not proof of stopping, and support must be negotiated. Keep a compatible operation-status path.

title: LangGraph persistence
date_status_reading_depth: Current official documentation; persistence/checkpoint overview.
lesson_and_limit: Durable orchestration may help complex human interactions. Use a persistent store; checkpoint state does not replace a host mutation ledger.

title: LangGraph interrupts
date_status_reading_depth: Current official documentation; replay and side-effect sections.
lesson_and_limit: Resuming can rerun code before an interrupt. Make scene commands idempotent and separate irreversible side effects from replayable computation.

title: GraphRAG
date_status_reading_depth: Current official documentation overview.
lesson_and_limit: Text-derived entities, relationships and community summaries support retrieval. This is different from a scene graph, workflow graph or learned geometry model. Test against simple retrieval first.

title: Building effective agents
date_status_reading_depth: 19 Dec 2024; official engineering article, workflow/agent discussion.
lesson_and_limit: Predictable workflows and more autonomous agents solve different needs. Start with measurable bounded stages; avoid complexity added only because an agent framework exists.

title: Writing effective tools for agents
date_status_reading_depth: 11 Sep 2025; official engineering guidance, overview/relevant tool-design material.
lesson_and_limit: Give tools clear jobs and evaluate their usefulness. Cyrus needs supported task coverage and actionable errors, not every property exposed separately.

title: Demystifying evals for AI agents
date_status_reading_depth: 9 Jan 2026; official engineering article, definitions/grader sections.
lesson_and_limit: Evaluate the real final state with deterministic, human and calibrated model checks. Task traces and a model's success claim are not the outcome.

title: 3ds Max 2027 Python threading
date_status_reading_depth: Max 2027 official documentation; full short page.
lesson_and_limit: Worker Python threads cannot call `pymxs`; the former token mechanism is deprecated/nonfunctional. Keep scene interaction on the supported host path and copied-data inference outside.

title: OpenTelemetry logging
date_status_reading_depth: Current official specification overview and correlation guidance.
lesson_and_limit: Shared trace/span/resource context can correlate diagnostics. The local pilot can adopt field conventions without deploying a distributed observability service.
